items.title: Will TIGER NUTS Tofu? AKA earth almond, chufa, atadwe and so many more names 😂 | Mary's Test Kitchen

items.title: Cultured Vegan Cheese with HEMP SEEDS! Should YOU try it?
items.description: It's high time to try HEMP SEEDS on Will It Cheese?! My friends, I promise I'm not joking. This started as a very standard “Will it Cheese?” episode using hemp seeds, cultures, and time. But during the process, part of the curds transformed into something completely different. Completely chickeny. In this video, I try to find out: - will hemp hearts turn into cheese? - what will it taste like? - should you make it too? To do that, I'm pushing hemp seeds through the full cheese-making process: blending, curdling, culturing, pressing, and aging—to see how far they can go. Along the way, we’ll taste, troubleshoot, and figure out whether hemp belongs in the cheese world… or somewhere else. If you’ve been following the “Will it Cheese?” series, you already know things don’t always go according to plan. But this one might be the strangest result yet.
